nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances in BlankToken; written directly without SafeMath in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances; constructor sets infinite allowances and transferFrom decrements it unchecked.
Constant token decimals set to 18.
Total token supply, used in list() to compute owner allocation.
Token name string 'Blank Token'.

Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used for addLiquidityETH.

Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor and used in access checks.
Computed Uniswap pair address between wETH and this token.
BlankToken constructor: sets owner, derives uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
Payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom guarded by checkLimits modifier; mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address.
Modifier restricting transferFrom callers using owner, uniPair and tx.origin checks.
Internal pure function that computes the Uniswap CREATE2 pair address.
Owner-only function that mints allocations, adds liquidity on Uniswap and distributes tokens in a loop.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance and transfer authorization.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the Uniswap deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Origin address used as an authorization condition inside checkLimits.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in the token's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath, allowing underflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing balance inflation.
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100 unchecked arithmetic used to mint to owner.
External call to IUniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value} before state finalization.
Authorization decision based on tx.origin == owner, vulnerable to phishing via intermediary contracts.
balanceOf[address(this)] = _numList directly overwrites the contract's own balance.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting full privileges to the deployer.
Constructor derives uniPair through pairFor.
Constructor writes infinite allowances into the allowance mapping.
Constructor grants msg.sender unlimited allowance over the pair.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom().
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom().
checkLimits modifier gates execution of transferFrom.
checkLimits allows callers whose tx.origin equals owner.
tx.origin is used as an authorization credential in the modifier.
transferFrom decrements the allowance with raw subtraction.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] with raw subtraction.
transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] with raw addition.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from the allowance.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from the sender balance.
User-supplied _to receives the added balance.
delegate() forwards execution to an arbitrary delegatecall.
Attacker-controlled bytes b become the delegatecall payload.
Attacker-controlled address a becomes the delegatecall target.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner.
Owner state variable is compared to the caller before delegatecall.
list() makes an external call to the Uniswap router before finishing state updates.
Deadline for addLiquidityETH is computed from block.timestamp.
list() computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 without SafeMath.
list() overwrites the contract's own balance with _numList.
list() requires msg.sender == owner.
Owner state variable guards the privileged list() function.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approve() mutates the allowance mapping.
_numList is assigned directly to balanceOf[address(this)].
_numList is passed to the external liquidity call.
list() requires _tos.length == _amounts.length before the distribution loop.
pairFor() returns the computed pair local variable.
Factory parameter feeds the CREATE2 address computation.
tokenA is sorted into local token0.
tokenB is sorted into local token1.
token0 is hashed into the pair address.
token1 is hashed into the pair address.
